_comment: Quests (generated by tools/gen_quests.py): regular quests across the bands, a three-city letter chain, dungeon bosses, and a three-part epic chain per class. Steps: kill, collect (counted from the pack; quest items with drops_from fall only while needed), talk/deliver. rewards.xp is in levels.

quests.name: Vermin in the Glade
quests.offer: Rats and beetles are eating the farmers out of the Emberglade, east of the gate. Thin them out: eight should do it.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Good work. The farmers will sleep easier.

steps.text: Slay 8 in The Emberglade

quests.name: Skulks on the Road
quests.offer: Skulk raiders have been ambushing carts on the glade road. Put six of them down.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: That will teach them to rob the Emberhold road.

steps.text: Slay 6 in The Emberglade

quests.name: Beetle Shells for Tansy
quests.offer: Bring me four beetle carapaces from the Emberglade, dearie. I grind them for my knees.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Lovely, lovely. My knees thank you.

steps.text: Collect 4 beetle carapaces

quests.name: Whiskers and Wisdom
quests.offer: Five rat whiskers, if you please. Do not ask what for.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Perfect. Now, do not ask.

steps.text: Collect 5 rat whiskers

quests.name: A Letter to Thornwood
quests.offer: Carry this letter to Elder Mirrin in Thornwood. The waystone keeper can send you, or walk if you have the legs.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Mirrin's reply is on its way? Splendid.

steps.text: Deliver the letter to Elder Mirrin in Thornwood
steps.say: Ah, Wenlow's hand. I shall write back at once.

quests.name: The Briar-bound Reply
quests.offer: Take my reply on to Marshal Durga in Cragmouth. She must hear it too.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Thornwood's word, at last. Here: Cragmouth's seal, for Wenlow.

steps.text: Carry Mirrin's reply to Marshal Durga in Cragmouth
steps.say: Thornwood's word, at last. Here: Cragmouth's seal, for Wenlow.

quests.name: The Three Seals
quests.offer: Bring Cragmouth's seal back to Scholar Wenlow in Emberhold. Three cities, one accord.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: All three seals! The accord is renewed. You have done the realm a quiet service.

steps.text: Bring the stone seal to Scholar Wenlow
steps.say: All three seals! The accord is renewed. You have done the realm a quiet service.

quests.name: Bones Beneath the Glade
quests.offer: Something is digging up the old battlefield. The Rattlebone Warren, in the east of the glade. Break eight of the dead.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Eight fewer. But something commands them.

steps.text: Slay 8 in Rattlebone Warren

quests.name: The Rattle King
quests.offer: The dead have a king, they say: the Rattle King, in the deepest pit of the warren. End him.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The Rattle King, broken at last. Take this, with the Watch's thanks.

steps.text: Slay The Rattle King in Rattlebone Warren

quests.name: Wolves of Briarwatch
quests.offer: Wolves and worse are running bold in Briarwatch Wood, north of our gate. Cull eight.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The wood is quieter. Thank you.

steps.text: Slay 8 in Briarwatch Wood

quests.name: Thieves in the Wood
quests.offer: Brigands have made camp in Briarwatch. The wood will not have them. Nor will I.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Well struck.

steps.text: Slay 6 in Briarwatch Wood

quests.name: Stolen Trinkets
quests.offer: The brigands rob pilgrims of their charms. Bring back four of them and I will see them returned.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Every one of these is someone's grandmother's. Bless you.

steps.text: Collect 4 stolen trinkets

quests.name: The Skulk Problem
quests.offer: Ten skulks, from the Cragfoot Hills below the gate. Bring me ten fewer skulks.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Ten fewer skulks. A fine evening's work.

steps.text: Slay 10 in Cragfoot Hills

quests.name: Gill's Shell Collection
quests.offer: Skulks carry little charms. I collect them. Three, and I will make it worth your while.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Hah! A fine set.

steps.text: Collect 3 skulk charms

quests.name: Scales in the Fen
quests.offer: Mirefolk are crossing the fens at night, raiding the boardwalk camps. Drive eight of them back into the water.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: They will think twice.

steps.text: Slay 8 in The Saltmarsh Fens

quests.name: The Serpent Idols
quests.offer: The mirefolk carry idols of their serpent god. Bring me three; I want to know what they worship.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: So it is true. They worship something in the Hollow.

steps.text: Gather 3 Mirefolk Idols in The Saltmarsh Fens

quests.name: Mirefang
quests.offer: Their god is real: a serpent grown huge in the drowned cave they call Mirefang Hollow, in the west of the fens. Kill it.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The Mirefang is dead? Then the fens may be ours again.

steps.text: Slay Mirefang in Mirefang Hollow

quests.name: Herons of Ill Omen
quests.offer: Herons and crows pick at the dead in the fens and carry the sickness. Eight of them, please.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Thank you. The camp cook is relieved.

steps.text: Slay 8 in The Saltmarsh Fens

quests.name: Serpents of the Shore
quests.offer: The shore crawls with serpents since the Bastion sank. Ten of them, and the fishers can work again.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The fishers send their thanks, and a little coin.

steps.text: Slay 10 in Duskmere Shore

quests.name: The Broken Lens
quests.offer: The great lens shattered when the light failed. The shore folk have picked over the shards; take four back from them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Four. It is a start. One day the light will shine again.

steps.text: Gather 4 Lighthouse Lens Shards in Duskmere Shore

quests.name: The Drowned Admiral
quests.offer: Admiral Grell went down with the Bastion, and he still keeps its watch. The fort lies in the east of the shore. Give him rest.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Rest, old admiral. Thank you, friend.

steps.text: Slay Admiral Grell, the Drowned in The Sunken Bastion

quests.name: The Ogre Clans
quests.offer: The Redrock ogres are pushing toward the shore. East of here, in the badlands. Push back: eight of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The badlands will be quieter.

steps.text: Slay 8 in The Redrock Badlands

quests.name: The Cinder Foreman
quests.offer: The ogres work slaves in the Cinderdeep Mines, in the badlands' far corner, under a brute they call the Foreman. Break his whip.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Free, all of them. You did a good thing.

steps.text: Slay The Cinder Foreman in The Cinderdeep Mines

quests.name: The Waking Trees
quests.offer: The trees of Hollowpine are waking angry, and spiders nest in them. West of the Duskmere. Calm eight, any way you can.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The forest sighs. Thank you.

steps.text: Slay 8 in Hollowpine Forest

quests.name: Horrors of the Gloomfen
quests.offer: North of Hollowpine lies the Gloomfen, where horrors breed in the black water. Eight fewer, and the Flame will be pleased.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The Flame is pleased.

steps.text: Slay 8 in Gloomfen Bog

quests.name: The Pale Abbot
quests.offer: Beneath the Gloomfen sleeps the abbey of Hollowmere, and its abbot does not sleep at all. End his vigil.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The abbot rests. The Flame thanks you, and so do I.

steps.text: Slay The Pale Abbot in The Hollowmere Crypts

quests.name: Ash on the Wind
quests.offer: The Ashen Cult is gathering on the steppe. Ten of their faithful, and their rites will falter.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Their fires are fewer tonight.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Shattered Steppe

quests.name: The Plains Hunters
quests.offer: The plains stalkers are taking our horses. Ten of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The herd is safe. For now.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Shattered Steppe

quests.name: The Storm Herald
quests.offer: Their leader calls the lightning from the Stormspire Ruins, in the steppe's far corner. Silence the Storm Herald.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The storm breaks. Well done.

steps.text: Slay The Storm Herald in The Stormspire Ruins

quests.name: Essence of Frost
quests.offer: North of the steppe, the Frostveil's creatures carry a cold that never melts. Bring me four essences; the alchemists pay well.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Cold as the grave. Perfect.

steps.text: Gather 4 Frost Essences in Frostveil Tundra

quests.name: The Root Mother
quests.offer: Beneath the Frostveil, warm caves; in them, roots; at their heart, something that feeds. Kill the Root Mother.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The roots wither. The tundra will freeze clean again.

steps.text: Slay The Root Mother in The Gloomroot Caverns

quests.name: Cores of the Cinderspire
quests.offer: East of the steppe, the Cinderspire's creatures burn from within. Four of their cores, and our forges will never go cold.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Still burning. Wonderful.

steps.text: Gather 4 Cinder Cores in The Cinderspire Wastes

quests.name: The Burning Faithful
quests.offer: The cult's zealots keep their fires in the Cinderspire Wastes. Ten of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The wastes burn a little less.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Cinderspire Wastes

quests.name: Trolls of the Ash
quests.offer: Trolls and wyrmlings hunt the ash between here and the Stormcrown. Ten of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Ten fewer. The reach thanks you.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Ashen Reach

quests.name: The Deathless Vigil
quests.offer: The deathless keep their vigil across the reach. Break ten of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Ten more at rest.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Ashen Reach

quests.name: High Priest Vaurn
quests.offer: The Deathless Sanctum lies in the east of the reach. Its high priest would make the whole realm deathless. Stop him.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Vaurn is dead. Truly dead. I did not think it could be done.

steps.text: Slay High Priest Vaurn in The Deathless Sanctum

quests.name: The Obsidian Tyrant
quests.offer: The Obsidian Citadel, in the west of the reach: a fortress of black glass, and a tyrant who rules it. Gather a raid. Break him.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The citadel is shattered. The realm will sing of this.

steps.text: Slay The Obsidian Tyrant in The Obsidian Citadel

quests.name: Drakes Above the Clouds
quests.offer: North of the reach, the Stormcrown. The Emberwyrm's children nest on its peaks. Ten of them.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: Ten. The mother will notice.

steps.text: Slay 10 in The Stormcrown Peaks

quests.name: The Emberwyrm
quests.offer: She sleeps in the burning heart of the Stormcrown, on a hoard a thousand years old. The Emberwyrm. Gather everyone you trust.
quests.progress: Not yet finished? There is no shame in taking your time. There is shame in giving up.
quests.complete: The Emberwyrm is slain. The fires that scarred the reach are cold at last. You are a legend.

steps.text: Slay The Emberwyrm in The Emberwyrm's Lair

quests.name: Warrior's Calling
quests.offer: You have grown strong, Warrior. Strong enough, perhaps, for what our order keeps. Carry this writ to Ashwarden Kell; they will know what it means.
quests.complete: Ashwarden Kell has read it? Then the trials begin.

steps.text: Bring the writ to Ashwarden Kell
steps.say: A writ from the Warriors' order... So, they think you are ready. Go back; tell them I agree.

steps.text: Return to Warlord Hagen of the Unbowed
steps.say: Good. Now the real work.

quests.name: The Warrior's Trial
quests.offer: In the depths of The Deathless Sanctum lie shards of the power our order's first Warrior wielded. Bring me three.
quests.complete: Three. Feel how they hum together?

steps.text: Gather 3 Ancient Shards in The Deathless Sanctum

quests.name: Oathbreaker, Blade of the Unbowed
quests.offer: The shards will wake only in the presence of a great death. Slay High Priest Vaurn, and I will forge what is yours by right.
quests.complete: It is done. Take it: Oathbreaker, Blade of the Unbowed. Our order's first Warrior would be proud.

steps.text: Slay High Priest Vaurn

quests.complete: It is done. Take it: Elemental Conduit. Our order's first Magician would be proud.

steps.text: Slay The Storm Herald

quests.name: Necromancer's Calling
quests.offer: You have grown strong, Necromancer. Strong enough, perhaps, for what our order keeps. Carry this writ to Ashwarden Kell; they will know what it means.
quests.complete: Ashwarden Kell has read it? Then the trials begin.

steps.text: Bring the writ to Ashwarden Kell
steps.say: A writ from the Necromancers' order... So, they think you are ready. Go back; tell them I agree.

steps.text: Return to The Pale Master Voss
steps.say: Good. Now the real work.

quests.name: The Necromancer's Trial
quests.offer: In the depths of The Deathless Sanctum lie shards of the power our order's first Necromancer wielded. Bring me three.
quests.complete: Three. Feel how they hum together?

steps.text: Gather 3 Ancient Shards in The Deathless Sanctum
